name: Bodyweight Squat

instructions.description: Stand tall with feet about shoulder width apart and your chest lifted.
Brace your core, send your hips back, and bend your knees to lower until your thighs are as low as comfortable.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and your heels on the ground throughout the descent.
Exhale as you press through your feet to return to standing and fully extend your hips.

performanceMetrics.notes: Perform controlled repetitions with full pain-free range.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a chair behind you to reduce depth demands and improve confidence.
Add front-loaded resistance to increase strength demand.

commentsNotes: Keep the spine neutral rather than rounding forward.
Stop the descent before form breaks or pain appears.
